Package electionsystem

Class Election

java.lang.Object
electionsystem.Election
Direct Known Subclasses:
MV, Plurality, STV
public abstract class Election extends Object
Abstract base class for election systems. Provides common functionality for both STV and Plurality elections. Written by Finn Gidden

    • parseBallotsFromFile

      protected void parseBallotsFromFile(String filename)
      Parses ballots from a CSV file. Expected format: Line 1: Algorithm Line 2: Seats Line 3: ballotID,candidate1,candidate2... Line 4+: ballotID,rank,rank,rank...
      Parameters:
      filename - The ballot file to parse
